//: Each entry under `models` is an addressable model that the agent can talk to.
Each entry under `roles` maps a logical role (planner, coder, summarizer) onto
one of those models. You can change a model assignment at runtime in the REPL

qwen-coder.description: Strong coding model with native Ollama tool calling. Default executor.

deepseek-r1.description: Reasoning-focused model. Used for planning phases; <think> blocks are stripped before handoff.

llama-fast.description: Small, quick model for summarization and lightweight follow-ups.
